node.label: Criminal laws (BNSS, BNS)
node.summary: New criminal laws as they are applied in news events.

facts.text: The **Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita** replaced the CrPC 1973 from **1 July 2024**, along with the BNS (for IPC) and the BSA (for the Evidence Act).
facts.plain: The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita replaced the CrPC 1973 from 1 July 2024, along with the BNS (for IPC) and the BSA (for the Evidence Act).

facts.text: A Jantar Mantar protester was held under **Sections 126 and 170 of the BNSS** (security for keeping the peace; arrest to prevent offences). An FIR named **22** protesters.
facts.plain: A Jantar Mantar protester was held under Sections 126 and 170 of the BNSS (security for keeping the peace; arrest to prevent offences). An FIR named 22 protesters.

facts.text: Union Home Minister Amit Shah said Chandigarh will be India's first city to become drug-free; Chandigarh Police have achieved a **93% conviction rate** in NDPS Act cases since the new criminal laws took effect (8,206 FIRs registered since 4 August 2024).
